title: Cover final delegation capacity admission after a concurrent create passes the precheck
outcome: A behavioral race-seam test separately exercises the final locked-insertion per-request capacity check, preserving total six for incoming read-only reviewers and total four otherwise, with no child created by a refused request.
acceptance: A deterministic controlled race or existing seam lets another delegation become nonterminal between the initial precheck and final insertion check; the later request is refused with the actual total and its applicable limit.

The refused request leaves no child delegation/session or isolated worktree, and coverage distinguishes read-only reviewer capacity from another supported request kind without source-text or instruction-file assertions.
